from pathlib import Path
import textwrap, importlib.util
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687674/attempts/fe7b32dd748346a8b1b7c0aebff056b5/system/state/workspace/programs/task-fcccb717.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
src='''def transform(grid):
    """Expand diagonal color samples into a periodic diagonal pattern."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    coords = {}
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value:
                coords.setdefault(value, []).append((r, c))
    if not coords:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The given color marks lie on parallel diagonals. Select their invariant:
    # r+c for anti-diagonals, or r-c for down-right diagonals.
    sum_score = sum(len({r + c for r, c in pts}) for pts in coords.values())
    diff_score = sum(len({r - c for r, c in pts}) for pts in coords.values())
    key_fn = (lambda r, c: r + c) if sum_score <= diff_score else (lambda r, c: r - c)
    period = len(coords)
    palette = {}
    for value, pts in coords.items():
        residues = {key_fn(r, c) % period for r, c in pts}
        for residue in residues:
            palette[residue] = value
    # Every residue of the repeating color sequence is represented by a sample.
    return [[palette[(key_fn(r, c) % period)] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''
p.write_text(src)
# execute the saved program
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_transform', p)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
